places.quote: I must be moving towards the City.
places.note: Used as a name for the financial district; Mr Dorrit rides there and the action takes place there.

places.as_written: the golden Street of the Lombards
places.quote: making a magnificent progress to that befitting destination, the golden Street of the Lombards.
places.note: Archaic-style name for Lombard Street; Mr Dorrit alights and comes out of the bank there.

places.quote: in Westminster Abbey and Saint Paul’s Cathedral put together, on any Sunday in the year.
